title: Days in a month, century years
description: Bug report for the calendar helper that returns the number of days in a given month of a given year. February of some years comes out wrong. Fix the program. The complete rule is: a year below 1 is an error with the message "invalid year"; otherwise a month below 1 or above 12 is an error with the message "invalid month" (the year is checked first). January, March, May, July, August, October and December have 31 days; April, June, September and November have 30; February has 29 days in a leap year and 28 otherwise. A year is a leap year when it is divisible by 4, except that a year divisible by 100 is a leap year only if it is also divisible by 400.
notes: Bug: leap test is year % 4 == 0 only, so century years (1900, 2100, 1700) get 29. 2000 and 1600 are leap (400 rule). Tests never divide a negative operand: the year guard runs before any % (year -4 and 0 return early). Invalid year wins over invalid month.
